responsibility: This definition file is the backend’s canonical database of Linux eBPF kernel helper functions. It enumerates each helper in kernel UAPI order together with the minimum supported kernel version, the helper’s symbolic and program-visible names, and a compact type signature description for its return value and arguments, including varargs cases. The BPF target uses this table to generate or validate helper declarations and attribute-driven helper-call handling in the surrounding BPF support files, tying -mkernel version selection to which helper interfaces are considered available.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/bpf/bpf-helpers.h, which exposes the helpers as user-visible macros, inline wrappers, attributes, and compatibility declarations for eBPF C programs, this .def file is the backend’s internal master list of helper metadata: ordered DEF_HELPER entries with kernel-version availability, helper IDs/names, and compact type signatures that other BPF support code can consume to generate or validate those interfaces.
